hypothesis_origin: Batch 18 observed that the 10 percent tier was weak while the 20 and 30 percent tiers had materially stronger future rank IC
interpretation: retrospective follow-up hypothesis; cannot become final without untouched forward evidence

primary_rule.name: strong_confidence_guarded
primary_rule.thresholds: expanding percentiles of raw confidence strictly before each decision

risk_guards.information_available: ML returns realized no later than the current decision

accounting.allocation_turnover: absolute change in ML sleeve weight

promotion_gates.paired_bootstrap_10bps: one-sided 95 percent lower bounds for both Sharpe and annual-return differences greater than zero
promotion_gates.full_period_100bps: annual return and Sharpe both greater than frozen core
promotion_gates.confidence_calibration: active-minus-inactive future rank IC point estimate and serial-block-bootstrap lower bound both greater than zero
